title: Piloto — your pilot knows the course
metaDesc: A personal pilot for your energy, routine and health. Two buttons a day: battery in the morning, what gave and what drained energy at night. No diagnoses, no typing.
heroTitle: Where your energy goes — and where it comes from
heroSub: Two buttons a day. Morning: your battery. Evening: what gave you energy and what took it. After a week you can see what feeds you.
introNote: Nothing is stored on this page: your records stay with you.

mod.pulso: Energy: battery in the morning, sources and leaks at night, a weekly summary.
mod.bussola: Course: where you are heading — goals and horizon. In progress.
mod.rotina: Routine: reminders for what repeats — car, deadlines, documents.
mod.saude: Health: when to check and with whom — no diagnoses.

disclaimer: Not medicine and not psychology: the pilot counts and reminds, it does not diagnose.
honest: No interpretations, no promises. Buttons only, two taps a day at most.
